pass_1.finding: The defining article says 4sU-labeled RNA is fragmented before selection so only newly synthesized labeled pieces are recovered. It describes TT-seq as an extension of 4sU-seq, not a disclosure of NuGEN adapter strands.

pass_2.locations: Author-hosted original Science PDF p.1, web text lines 61–98 and Fig. 1 caption lines 256–259; TT-seq supplementary methods lines 20–32 inspected after source-bundle oligo scraper
pass_2.finding: The 2016 original explicitly explains that TT-seq fragments 4sU-labeled RNA before selecting labeled fragments to eliminate the 5′ bias of earlier 4sU-seq. It does not specify the NuGEN library adapter or index-primer sequences in these method sections.

source_checklist.locator: Dölken et al. 2008 original RNA article DOI 10.1261/rna.1136108, university-hosted publisher PDF https://www.pure.ed.ac.uk/ws/portalfiles/portal/8206533/High_resolution_gene_expression_profiling_for_simultaneous_kinetic_parameter_analysis_of_RNA_synthesis_and_decay.pdf

pass_1.locations: Original Dölken 2008 publisher PDF pp.3 and 12, especially PDF text lines 679–713; TT-seq supplement lines 20–32 and ref.26 lines 1114–1117 establish inheritance; TT-seq source-bundle oligo scraper run first
pass_1.finding: Ref.26 is explicitly Dölken 2008. Its capture method uses EZ-Link Biotin-HPDP to derivatize 4sU, removes excess reagent, binds to µMACS streptavidin columns, washes, then elutes labeled RNA with DTT. TT-seq delegates purification to this method, so the reagent identity is source-supported, though TT-seq does not repeat its volumes.

pass_2.locations: TT-seq original supplementary methods lines 20–32 and reference 26 lines 1114–1117; Dölken 2008 original RNA publisher PDF web text lines 679–713, p.12
pass_2.finding: Independently confirmed TT-seq cites Dölken 2008 for purification. Dölken directly specifies 4sU thiol labeling with EZ-Link Biotin-HPDP, excess-biotin removal, capture on µMACS streptavidin beads/columns, washing, and DTT elution. This supports the inherited capture chemistry, not the later NuGEN adapter sequence.

missing_claims.claim: Historical NuGEN Ovation Human Blood adapter and index-primer bases
missing_claims.evidence: Original Schwalb article, Science supplement and cited Dölken 2008 capture predecessor read twice; none identifies historical NuGEN kit adapter/index bases. The relevant original NuGEN kit guide remains unavailable.

conclusion: Two independent located reads now cover the original Science article, supplement and cited Dölken 2008 capture method. HPDP-biotin/streptavidin capture with DTT release is supported; the relevant historical NuGEN kit guide is unavailable, so its adapter/index bases remain blocked and no absence claim is accepted.
